mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for developing an AI search content strategy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Developing an AI search content strategy typically involves several steps. First, an in-depth analysis of your existing content and target audience's search behavior, focusing on natural language queries and intent. Next, semantic keyword research identifies entities and topics related to your business. Content gap analysis helps identify missing information or opportunities. Then, content creation or optimization begins, focusing on comprehensiveness, clarity, and schema markup implementation. Finally, continuous monitoring and adjustment are crucial to adapt to evolving AI algorithms and user needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves audience and content analysis, semantic keyword research, gap identification, content creation/optimization with schema, and continuous monitoring.
